date_note: Reported as happening on Thursday 26 November; the page gives no earlier day.
title: EasyEquities suspends client access after cybersecurity incident
summary: EasyEquities, an investment platform owned by JSE-listed Purple Group, temporarily suspended access on Thursday to protect clients after a cybersecurity incident, The Citizen reports in an article from Moneyweb. The company says it is investigating with independent IT experts. The article does not state the cause, whether data was accessed, or when access returns.
plain: South African investment platform EasyEquities has paused client access while it investigates a cybersecurity incident. The report does not say what happened or when access will return.
exec: Clients of the platform cannot log in for now; the article does not say how many are affected.
action: EasyEquities asks clients not to log in until it confirms by email and social media that access is restored, and not to share passwords or one-time codes with anyone claiming to be from the platform.

validation.note: The Citizen republishes Moneyweb's article, so one publisher; the Moneyweb page answered 403 and could not be read.

review.note: Compared date, suspension, advice against The Citizen page
